title: More Splashes
description: Adds more splashes to the game
body:
If you want something that looks and feels like Minecraft's splashes, this is where you'll get them! This has a growing amount of splashes while keeping the default ones!
# How to install?

## Prism Launcher
Click on an instance, press edit and go to resource packs, search up 'More Splashes' and it should show up
## Modrinth app
Go to an instance, press the 'Install content' button, select resource packs, search up 'More Splashes' and it should show up
## Vanilla Launcher
### Windows
Press Windows key and the 'R' key, type '%appdata%\.minecraft\resourcepacks' and download the resource pack. Place the resource pack in that folder once it finishes downloading
### MacOS
Unknown (to macos users please make a pull request on the github for this)
### Linux
Unknown (to linux users please make a pull request on the github for this)
